descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
With BUILD & BREACH CQB, turn your living room, garage, backyard, office, or training space into a room-clearing CQB environment in seconds. Build a layout, grab your weapon, stack on a door, clear rooms, identify threats, and run it again with a completely different scenario.

Build scenarios directly inside the headset by placing walls, doors, furniture, obstacles, and NPCs. Or use the free Build & Breach Builder companion desktop app to create custom rooms on your computer and send them directly to the headset.

Scan your real environment and use its actual walls, furniture, and objects as part of the scenario, then add virtual elements on top to create the layout you want.

Customize NPC behaviors for different situations, or generate randomized rooms to train against layouts you have never seen before.

Move through your actual space, work angles, clear doorways, identify threats, and make decisions under pressure. Save, modify, replay, and review scenarios for repeatable training without a fixed virtual map or dedicated facility.

Build it. Run it. Review it. Improve it.

BUILD & BREACH

TRAIN ANYWHERE, ANYTIME.
